annotation.title_clean: Empowering the Future of Digital Learning: UNESCO Initiated Regional Dialogue on Equitable, Ethical and Human-Centred Use of ICT and AI in Education
annotation.title_en: Empowering the Future of Digital Learning: UNESCO Initiated Regional Dialogue on Equitable, Ethical and Human-Centred Use of ICT and AI in Education
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO news article on a three-day symposium in Bishkek (28–30 October 2025) for Central Asia, Iran and Pakistan on equitable, ethical, human-centred ICT and AI in education, aligned with UNESCO's AI ethics Recommendation and AI competency frameworks. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Symposium capacity-building for 37 participants from Member States on AI in education
Promotes a 'human dimension' approach grounded in human rights, democracy and rule of law
Aligned with UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI (2022) and AI competency frameworks for students and teachers (2024)
Emphasises AI literacy and teachers as key drivers of change
